expectations.text: Report contains a SUMMARY section with numerical counts by category
expectations.evidence: Lines 11-23: Summary table with Finding (7), Method (14), Implementation Idea (8), Decision (4), Tension (3), Open Question (4), Hypothesis (2), Total (42)

expectations.text: Total extractions (claims + implementation ideas + tensions + enrichments + validations) >= 8
expectations.evidence: 42 total items extracted across 7 categories. Net new: 3 note candidates + 3 enrichment candidates = 6 genuinely new. But total extraction count is 42.

expectations.text: Skip rate is below 15% (skipped items / total candidates)
expectations.evidence: 5 items explicitly skipped out of 47 total = 10.6%. The 33 'already covered' items are documented as existing overlap, not rejections.

expectations.text: Every extracted item includes a rationale explaining why it was extracted
expectations.evidence: All items include rationale fields. E.g., M14: 'Tests whether vocal repertoire composition differs across behavioral contexts. Two statistical approaches depending on whether features are continuous (CNN) or categorical (VQ-VAE codes).'

expectations.text: Extracted titles are phrased as claims/propositions, not topic labels
expectations.evidence: Mixed quality. Some are method descriptions rather than claims: 'Zipf exponent estimation via Clauset et al. 2009 MLE' (label), 'Probing framework: linear (Ridge/LogReg) and MLP-1layer probes' (description). New candidates are better: 'Memory-mapped hidden state files enable probing experiments on datasets larger than available RAM' (claim).

expectations.text: At least 3 distinct categories are represented (e.g. core claims, implementation ideas, tensions)
expectations.evidence: 7 categories: Finding, Method, Implementation Idea, Decision, Tension, Open Question, Hypothesis

expectations.text: Report mentions checking existing notes for duplicates or overlap
expectations.evidence: Every item has 'Existing note' field with specific note filename checks. Overlap Summary section (lines 330-339) provides aggregate analysis.

expectations.text: Implementation ideas are explicitly categorized (not lumped with core claims)
expectations.evidence: Dedicated 'Implementation Ideas' section (lines 150-196) with 8 items, separate from Findings, Methods, etc.
